name: Gugun no Sengo
source:
You have been manipulated by a retired veteran, your former superior Colonel Fabio, and are being subjected to a newlywed life that is almost like imprisonment. With the help of ally, try to escape this nightmare and regain your freedom!

This is a sequel to 'Sengo to Zatsuon. - End 2.' It assumes that you have played the previous installment.

*Includes depictions of sirens, violence, and PTSD.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14539]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
你遭到退役老兵——你的前任上司法比奥上校的笼络摆布，被迫过着近乎软禁般的新婚生活。借助同伴的力量，设法逃离这场噩梦、重获自由吧！

本作是《战后与杂音。》结局2的续篇，默认玩家已游玩过前作。

※包含防空警报、暴力及创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）相关描写。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14539]Novelgame[/url]]
